compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: proposal must be 'in scope' — it must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it has been submitted. If an application is partly out of scope, this must be reflected in the scoring and explained in the comments.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions: Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding for third-country participants: a third country participant or international organisation not listed in the General Annex to the Main Work Programme may only exceptionally receive funding if their participation is essential for carrying out the project (e.g. outstanding expertise, access to unique know-how, research infrastructure, particular geographical environments, key partners in emerging markets, or data access).

Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): proposal must declare whether hESC are used. If YES, evaluator must state whether use is or is not necessary to achieve the scientific objectives of the proposal, or declare that necessity cannot be assessed due to lack of information.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions: Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: proposal must declare whether human embryos are used. If YES, evaluator must explain how the human embryos will be used in the project.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions: Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: proposal must not include activities that (a) aim at human cloning for reproductive purposes, (b) intend to modify the heritable genetic heritage of human beings (except cancer treatment of gonads), (c) intend to create human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement including via somatic cell nuclear transfer, or (d) lead to the destruction of human embryos (e.g. to obtain stem cells). Must declare No or Yes with explanation.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions: Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: activities proposed must have an exclusive focus on civil applications. Activities intended to be used in military applications or that aim to serve military purposes cannot be funded. Must declare Yes (civil only) or No with explanation.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions: Exclusive focus on civil applications
